name: us-sam-tenders-mcp-server
displayName: SAM.gov US Federal Contracts & Grants Scraper (Keyless)
description: Keyless Streamable HTTP MCP server & Apify Actor for searching active US federal contract opportunities, RFPs, agencies, NAICS codes, and contracting officer contacts from SAM.gov.

tools.name: search_us_contracts
tools.description: Search active US federal contract opportunities, RFPs, and solicitations on SAM.gov without an API key.

tools.name: get_opportunity_details
tools.description: Fetch full details for a specific SAM.gov opportunity ID, including NAICS codes and contracting officer contact info.
